department: Faculty of Earth Sciences, Geography and Astronomy

deadline.value: Doctoral candidates apply to specific open PraeDoc positions advertised throughout the year.
deadline.quote: The University of Vienna is advertising 11 PhD positions (call for application opens in September 2026). We look forward to receiving applications from outstanding early-career researchers who wish to complete their PhD at the University of Vienna and actively participate in excellent research within an international environment.

entry_route.value: Doctoral and PhD programmes at the University of Vienna have a stipulated study duration of 6 semesters following completion of a master's programme.
entry_route.quote:
Doctoral/PhD programme
Stipulated degree programme duration 6 semesters + 2 tolerance semesters. You pay the tuition fee from the 9th semester onwards.

supervisor.value: University of Vienna doctoral admission requires finding a supervisor in advance and submitting a Declaration of Willingness to Supervise.
supervisor.quote: I have defined my intended doctoral project and found a supervisor for it | Declaration of Willingness to Supervise (PDF Form)

funding.value: Doctoral researchers appointed to PraeDoc positions are fully funded employees under the Austrian collective bargaining agreement.
funding.quote: seeking outstanding candidates for more than 40 fully funded PhD positions in the Life - and Natural Sciences.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: University of Vienna offers doctoral education in Faculty of Earth Sciences, Geography and Astronomy leading to Dr. rer. nat. or PhD degrees.
